integrations.project: Google Cloud Agent Compute Engine (ACE) + Agent Gateway
integrations.version: announced 2026-10-22; preview in coming months (not available)
capabilities: one hardware-isolated microVM (Cloud Hypervisor, own guest kernel, root) per agent session on Titan/Titanium IPU hosts
zero secrets in the sandbox: no credentials, API keys, OAuth refresh tokens or SA keys in memory or on disk; no metadata-server access
Agent Gateway in-flight token swap: validates user delegation + agent identity + node identity, evaluates egress/DLP policy, inserts the backend credential on the wire outside the microVM
four identities kept distinct (user, delegated on-behalf-of, SPIFFE Agent Workload Identity, Agent Workforce Identity); attestation keys held in the Titanium IPU outside the guest
no standard NIC/default gateway/VPC access in the microVM; all traffic via virtio-vsock to a local proxy then the off-node gateway
application-aware idle checkpoint/pause at near-zero active cost, CoW/DAX memory deduplication, per-microVM Hyperdisk persistence, snapshot/fork for eval sweeps
open-source sibling Agent Substrate on GKE available today with the same design (microVM/gVisor + credential-injecting egress proxies)
integrations.integration_mode: comparison + design-pattern reference only; no deployment (announced-only, no fleet GCP project). Full comparison: docs/ops/AGENT-COMPUTE-ENGINE-COMPARISON-2026-10-26.md
required_exports: if ever piloted: per-session SPIFFE workload identity + Agent Gateway audit logs into Provenance/HindSight as attested evidence
integrations.hard_gate: ACE removes credential theft from the sandbox; it does not remove policy-breadth risk - a compromised agent can still act through the gateway within its delegated scope and egress policy. Scoped grants remain the control, as with the Data Agent Kit IAM tier.
unresolved_questions: Availability: Google states preview 'in the coming months' (announcement 2026-10-22); no console/API/pricing exists today - revisit when the preview opens.
Requires a fleet GCP project + billing, which does not exist; this is the same owner-pending item gating Data Agent Kit activation (card-gated signup + gcloud sign-in session).

Cannot touch GitHub Actions lanes, the PAT-helper route, on-device Termux/B160V lanes, or vendor-hosted agent surfaces (Jules/Grok/Manus) - it hosts only the execution half of a fleet-built, GCP-hosted agent, of which the fleet currently has none.

Mirror proposals (fleet-native, owner/lane decision, not implemented by the comparison): prefer short-lived per-workflow credentials over new long-lived Actions secrets; put a credential-swap proxy in any future agent tool-egress path instead of injecting secrets into the agent environment.

wiring_rules: All adapters emit evidence into repository-owned JSONL/receipts before optional vendor-specific persistence.
No provider/model/runtime name becomes a hardcoded permanent routing hierarchy.
Simulation, live execution, review, and provenance records retain separate evidence status.
H0-H3 horizon and confidence are independent fields.
A HOLD resource remains fully documented but cannot enter active routing.
Future edge candidates must pass device, memory, thermal, energy, reproducibility, and provenance gates before promotion.
